newsitem.title: USA: High cotton prices trigger import quota -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: High cotton prices trigger import quota -- USDA.

text.p: High cotton prices triggered another U.S. special import quota, permitting entry of 44,607,955 kg (98,343,787 lb) of upland cotton, the Agriculture Department said Thursday.
The quota will be established January 18, and applies to cotton purchased not later than April 17, 1997, and entered into the United States not later than July 16, 1997.
A new special import quota has been triggered every week since Oct. 26, 1995.
